AJLH: Falling into the well, the mortal eats the sweet treats of Maya. ||1||
Falling into the well, the mortal is eating the sweets. (of passions)
12R4: Thinking and planning, the night of the life is passing away.
In thinking and reflecting the (life's) night passes away.

Thinking of the multifarious pleasure of the world, man reflects not on God, the sustainer of earth. Pause.
WC7X: Believing the shade of the tree to be permanent, he builds his house beneath it.
Deeming the tree's shade as immovable, man builds his home beneath it.

Death's noose is around his neck and mammon has aimed her arrow at him.

The sandy shore has fallen into the mouth of the waves.
CY1L: but the fool still believes that place to be permanent. ||3||
That place, the fool deems as permanent.
SUQ9: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Name of the Lord, the King.
In the guild of saints, I have meditated on the sovereign Lord.

Nanak lives by singing God's praises.

O body, with the soul, you are engaged in frolics.
Z0W6: with that, I am joined to you.
in her company you comest in contact with every one.
8TVR: With that, everyone longs for you;
In her company every one desires you.

Without her, none wishes to see you.
U9E2: Where is that detached soul now contained?
Where is that detached soul, now, contained?

MB8T: without it, you are reduced to dust. ||2||

C8YM: With that, you have honor and respect;

The detached soul neither dies nor is born.
